verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer materials point to OAuth scopes: a developer blog post titled 'Customizing scopes in the OAuth app authorization flow' and an OAuth guide. That suggests apps, including agents, can be granted narrowed permissions, but the evidence is only page titles with no detail on how scopes are defined or enforced. missing for 10: documented scope granularity (e.g. per-folder or read-only limits), token expiry and revocation controls, agent-specific credential issuance guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
